checks.name: second tab is rejected without stealing the active run
world reload exposes active-expedition recovery controls
recovery resumes same checkpoint and run
failed return pauses the encounter and retains active disk state
same return request retries successfully without a second-return dead end
lost acknowledgement retains the durable completed return
acknowledged return retry is idempotent in the actual browser
reopened world can return directly from the saved expedition binding

note: Actual browser navigation and UI; two explicitly injected HTTP 503 responses: before host receipt and after durable return acknowledgement. It is a fault test, not an observed disk failure or combat benchmark.
